text.en: Usable. The tokens are actually held in Fluid's Liquidity contract, and at every signing the program checks that its code is unchanged. Send a small amount the first time.
text.zh-TW: 可以用。代幣實際放在 Fluid 的 Liquidity 合約，程式每次簽名都確認它的程式碼沒變；第一次先送小額。

text.en: The fToken sends the deposit to Liquidity with `operate`, where the USDC is held
text.zh-TW: fToken 用 `operate` 把存款交給 Liquidity，USDC 放在那裡

text.en: In Liquidity's callback the fToken pulls the USDC from the Safe into Liquidity with `transferFrom`
text.zh-TW: 在 Liquidity 的回呼裡，fToken 用 `transferFrom` 把 USDC 從 Safe 拉進 Liquidity

pastTxsConclusion.en: The largest group of Safes that did not fit called only `deposit`, using an allowance given earlier. Others batched through a contract that is not an official MultiSend, or combined several vaults or protocols in one transaction. Every EOA that did not fit, and one Safe, called Fluid Lite's USDC vault (0x273DA948ACa9261043fbdb2a857BC255ECC29012), another product.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 不符合的 Safe 最多是只呼叫 `deposit`，用的是先前給的授權；其次是經由不是官方 MultiSend 的合約，或一筆裡合併多個 vault 或協議。所有不符合的 EOA 和一個 Safe 呼叫的是 Fluid Lite 的 USDC vault（0x273DA948ACa9261043fbdb2a857BC255ECC29012），是另一個產品。

text.en: fUSDC has existed for more than a year and is large. It fell sharply from its 2026-01 peak and, since mid-2026, has stayed at less than half of it. The largest holder owns about a tenth of the shares. The program's figures are in the Instance section.
text.zh-TW: fUSDC 已存在超過一年，規模很大。從 2026-01 的高點大幅縮小，2026 年中以後一直不到高點的一半；最大的持有人約占一成股份。程式量到的數字在「實例」區。

recommendation.en: Before you deposit, plan when you will withdraw: a large withdrawal can be delayed by Fluid's withdrawal limits.
recommendation.zh-TW: 存入前想好何時要提：大額提領可能受 Fluid 的提款上限延後。

text.en: Your USDC does not stay in fUSDC: in the same transaction it goes to Fluid's Liquidity contract, which holds the deposits of every Fluid market and lends them to Fluid's borrowing vaults and DEX pools. fUSDC only keeps account of your share.
text.zh-TW: 你的 USDC 不會留在 fUSDC：同一筆交易就轉進 Fluid 的 Liquidity 合約。Liquidity 集中保管 Fluid 各市場的存款，借給 Fluid 的借款 vault 和 DEX 池；fUSDC 只記你的份額。

title.zh-TW: 怎麼把 USDC 拿回來

text.en: A large withdrawal can be delayed: Liquidity lets fUSDC take out only part of its deposits at a time, a limit that grows back over time, and only what borrowers have not borrowed. A small withdrawal under the base limit is not throttled.
text.zh-TW: 大額提領可能要等：Liquidity 每次只讓 fUSDC 提出一部分存款，這個上限會隨時間慢慢放寬，而且只能提出沒被借走的部分。低於基本額度的小額提領不受限。

text.en: Liquidity's code and its admins are changed by Instadapp governance through a timelock with a 1-day delay. The admins it names can change the withdrawal limits and the interest rates at once, and its guardians can pause deposits and withdrawals of a token at once.
text.zh-TW: Liquidity 的程式碼和管理員由 Instadapp 治理經 timelock 修改，要等 1 天。治理指定的管理員可以立刻改提款上限和利率，guardian 可以立刻暫停某個代幣的存款和提款。

role.en: Fluid's USDC lending pool token (fUSDC): takes USDC and issues shares
role.zh-TW: Fluid 的 USDC 借貸池代幣（fUSDC），收 USDC、發股份

text.en: Fluid's GitHub deployments list (deployments.md, at commit 404d73f, still on main) gives this address for fToken_fUSDC on mainnet, and the file fToken_fUSDC.json gives it as address
text.zh-TW: Fluid GitHub 的部署清單（deployments.md，commit 404d73f，仍在 main）在 mainnet 下列出 fToken_fUSDC 是這個地址，fToken_fUSDC.json 檔的 address 也是

text.en: Fluid's docs page of lending tokens lists fUSDC with this address
text.zh-TW: Fluid 文件的借貸代幣頁列出 fUSDC 是這個地址

text.en: The LendingFactory's `computeToken` answers this address for the asset and the name fToken
text.zh-TW: LendingFactory 的 `computeToken` 對這個資產和名稱 fToken 回答的就是這個地址

text.en: Etherscan: verified contract name fToken. Its creation transaction was sent by 0x8e7fb4d4fabc504a4ad73d44e09080cb68960098 and deployed it through CREATE3
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：已驗證合約名 fToken，建立交易由 0x8e7fb4d4fabc504a4ad73d44e09080cb68960098 送出，經 CREATE3 部署
